title: Amazon MGM names Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond
dek: The studio ended months of rumour with a video on Monday. Denis Villeneuve will direct.
what: Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday 16 November 2026 that Robert Pattinson will play James Bond, according to the company's own news page. The announcement came as a video on the franchise's social accounts, and a post from the account @007 reading "Robert Pattinson is James Bond" went up at about 3 p.m. UTC.

Amazon says Denis Villeneuve will direct and Steven Knight is writing the script. Amy Pascal and David Heyman produce, with Tanya Lapointe as executive producer. Amazon quotes Pattinson: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime." It quotes Villeneuve: "He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new."
Earlier in November, outlets had reported that Pattinson screen-tested, and Amazon MGM had declined to comment. The Amazon page I read gives no release date.
why: Who plays Bond is a long-running public guessing game, the studio ended it with a single timed reveal, and a huge fan base shared the same clip at once.
next: A release date and the rest of the cast, once Amazon MGM gives them.
